documents.title: Specification and design-document system
documents.purpose: Authors write Markdown and metadata; the tool checks them and generates navigation and agent reading packages.
documents.audience: Specification and design-document authors, reviewers and tool implementers familiar with Markdown links, headings and basic Git snapshots; approval eligibility additionally requires the design-flow procedure named in the introduction.
documents.scope: Single-file and multi-file specifications and designs: who owns meanings and values, how checking and review work, and how agents receive material captured from one repository version.
documents.non_goals: Product contracts, HTML publication, a renderer, expression evaluation, semantic measurement conversion, independent requirement stores and general prose formatting.

sections.summary: Choose a reading path and see which authored sources produce checked navigation and agent input.
Follow a wrong capacity link through a visible error, correction, regenerated map and complete review input.
Place meanings and values once, then connect reading order, accepted names and direct links to those homes.
Connect obligations, refusals and evidence, then determine which tests a changed contract brings into review.
Run the pinned checker, distinguish errors from warnings and rebuild valid navigation after a failed or interrupted generation.
Select complete explanations from one snapshot and refuse unknown, stale or excessive assignments before dispatch.
Assign source ownership, review technical meaning and qualify real authoring without mistaking a structural pass for reader acceptance.
Find the observable obligations for authoring, checking, generation, context and review with reciprocal verification links.
Distinguish settled source and tool choices from unresolved differences between rules, code and approved intent.
Look up exact metadata keys, declaration grammar and callable assignments after learning what each source contributes.
Reproduce the bounded-batch fixture in an independent repository and inspect the exact files used throughout the tour.
Choose the command or diagnostic remedy for the batch correction and inspect executable-selector audit results.
Find behavioral regressions and real-run evidence that prove each obligation, including reader understanding and visible recovery.
